title: Chip Industry Technical Paper Roundup
summary: Recent technical papers detail advancements in WSe2 transistors, 2nm GAAFETs, and DRAM processing.

title: Swiss Glaciers Lose Over 5% Ice Volume
summary: Swiss glaciers experienced their second-biggest percentage drop in ice volume on record due to heat waves and low winter snow.

title: Backside Clock Meshes Improve 2nm Nanosheets
summary: Researchers explore backside clock meshes for 2nm GAAFET technology to minimize skew and power consumption.

title: GE HealthCare Acquires Radiopharmaceuticals Business
summary: GE HealthCare plans a $945 million acquisition to expand its presence in radiopharmaceuticals.

title: Goal-Oriented Wave Computing for Direction-of-Arrival Estimation
summary: Researchers explore goal-oriented training for tunable metasurfaces in wave-domain analog computing for direction-of-arrival estimation.

title: Pulsar Constellation and LEO GNSS Performance Study
summary: A new study analyzes LEO GNSS constellation deployment and its effects on positioning, navigation, and timing performance.

title: Reducing Contact Resistance in 2D Transistors for Advanced CMOS
summary: Researchers achieve low contact resistance in oxygen-doped WSe2 monolayer p-type transistors to advance CMOS technology.

title: Interplay Between Excitability and Noise in CMOS Spiking Neurons
summary: A physics-based simulation framework demonstrates how time-varying inputs reduce spike time jitter in CMOS analog spiking neurons.

title: Estimation-Aware Optimal Control for Mobile Sensor Target Tracking
summary: A proposed estimation-aware optimal control method accounts for nonlinear dynamics and continuous-time constraints in mobile sensor target tracking.

title: Whole-Body Planning for Human-Robot Cloth Co-Transportation
summary: A hierarchical planning framework combines learned cloth models and reduced-order manipulation to enable obstacle-aware deformable object co-transportation.

title: Inverse Cross-Spectral Neural Networks for Multivariate Time Series
summary: Inverse Cross-Spectral Neural Networks use inverse cross-spectral density matrices as graph shift operators to model stationary multivariate time series.

title: Quadrotor Vector Field Following Using Reduced-Attitude Representations
summary: Researchers proposed two vector field tracking controllers for quadrotors using reduced-attitude representations to enforce safety-critical control.

title: Robust Deep Learning Framework for Radar Target Detection
summary: A proposed robust learning framework called SL-RLF addresses partial label errors in deep-learning-based radar target detection using a symmetry-condition loss function.

title: Row-Parallel DRAM Computing Reduces Data-Reorganization Overhead
summary: Researchers published a paper on RAPID, a processing-using-memory architecture performing computation directly in DRAM to reduce data movement overhead.

title: Retention-Aware Inventory Control for Industrial Refrigeration
summary: This study formulates industrial refrigeration compressor control as a stochastic inventory problem to evaluate energy savings from pre-cooling while accounting for thermal losses.

title: Real Part of Butterfly Factorizations for Fast Transforms
summary: Researchers established conditions ensuring the preservation of sparse matrix structure when taking the real parts of complex-valued products for fast transforms.

title: Right Bregman Proximal Gradient for Poisson Inverse Problems
summary: A novel Bregman proximal algorithm is introduced for convex composite optimization and specialized to solve Poisson inverse problems.

title: Adaptive Inductor and Frequency Management for Power Converters
summary: A digitally controlled adaptive power conversion framework dynamically co-optimizes inductor configuration and switching frequency to improve efficiency across varied loads.

title: LogoJET and Roland DG Expand UV Printing Partnership
summary: LogoJET is adding Roland DG desktop, benchtop, and large-format UV flatbed printers to its industrial product portfolio.

title: MathWorks and MapmyIndia Partner for ADAS Development
summary: The integration combines high-definition maps with MATLAB, Simulink, and RoadRunner to simulate traffic and road conditions.

title: Synopsys Integrates EDA Tools with Agentic AI
summary: Synopsys has joined OpenAI to combine integrated circuit design electronic design automation with agentic artificial intelligence.

title: eVista XL Limited Edition Tiny House Unveiled
summary: The single-story tiny house makes smart use of its compact space to provide practical and comfortable living.

title: New Guide Addresses Geotechnical Risks of Problematic Soils
summary: A new book provides an integrated guide to understanding the behavior, risks, and engineering challenges associated with problematic soils in complex environments.
